ledger.note: 1474: elevation to a duchy. Emperor Frederick III 'elevated Christian I as Count of Holstein-Rendsburg to Duke of Holstein'; the page's German County of Holstein is 811-1474 and the Duchy of Holstein lasted until 1866. The state continues; the end here is the title's change. Christian I had become Count of Holstein-Rendsburg through the Treaty of Ribe (1460) after the Holstein-Rendsburg line died out (1459).

notes: One page used (state with no Cliopatria shape; the Holstein article covers the region and the duchy). Branches from 1290 (Holstein-Itzehoe repartitioned into Pinneberg 1290-1640, Plön 1290-1390 and Rendsburg 1290-1474) are not split on the map: the page has no territorial description of the branches. The 1386 enfeoffment of Gerhard VI, Count of Holstein-Rendsburg, with the Duchy of Schleswig is the duchy-of-schleswig dossier's. The union with the Danish crown from 1460 (Christian I elected Count) is a personal union, not drawn as a merger. The Holstein-Gottorp share of 1544 ('In 1544 they partitioned the Duchies of Holstein and of Schleswig') is not written: the Gottorp page gives no places beyond Gottorf Castle in Schleswig. The Duchy of Holstein (1474-1866) between this dossier and the Cliopatria row of 1848-1852 needs a dossier; 'The territory of Holstein was enlarged by the conquest of the independent Republic of Dithmarschen in 1559' is its gain.
